baseline_models.focus_anchor: كفروا بربهم / عذاب جهنم / بئس المصير
baseline_models.mechanism: Active rejection of the sovereign Lord initiates painful sanction, and المصير presents that sanction as a condemned terminal outcome rather than a passing episode.

activation_trace.role: Active occlusion of truth makes disbelief the initiating refusal rather than a passive absence.
Sovereignty and ownership identify whose authority the refusal contests.
Severe painful penalty supplies the consequence linking refusal to Hell.
The formal word of blame evaluates the endpoint, not merely the pain along the way.
Becoming toward an end turns Hell into the realized outcome of a trajectory.

changed_reading.before: Disbelievers receive Hell as punishment and a bad destination.
changed_reading.after: Those who actively cover or reject their sovereign Lord enter a painful consequence whose very culmination is condemned.

baseline_models.mechanism: When رب is heard as one who tends and completes, كفر can cover the benefaction itself; the punishment then admits a deprivation or weaning dimension and المصير fixes that severance as an abiding settlement.

activation_trace.role: Covering a benefaction makes the offense a denial of received nurture.
Gradual tending, repair, and completion make Lordship an ongoing sustaining relation.
Restraint, prevention, and weaning add deprivation to the punitive mechanism.
Painful penalty keeps the deprivation model anchored in the verse's ordinary punitive force.
A settled place turns severance from nurture into an abiding condition.

changed_reading.before: The verse assigns an external penalty to unbelief.
changed_reading.after: The verse can also portray the covering of a nurturing relation as ending in painful deprivation fixed into a final abode.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening frame joins comprehensive rule and deliberate measure to a test that exposes work; المصير therefore reads as an adjudicated result inside the same ordered sovereignty named by رب.

activation_trace.role: Sovereign Lordship anchors the destination within authority rather than outside it.
The endpoint branch receives the contextual logic of measured testing.
Comprehensive kingship supplies the governing domain in which the endpoint occurs.
Deliberate ordering and appraisal make the consequence measured rather than accidental.
A test that reveals condition supplies the disclosure stage before judgment.
Purposive deeds supply what the revealing test evaluates.

structural_cues: 67:1-2 places dominion, capacity, creation, testing, and work before the focus verdict.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sovereignty, deliberate measure, a revealing test, and purposive work; I infer that the focus destination is the test's adjudicated outcome. A live alternative is that these verses frame divine power without specifying the causal procedure of judgment.

changed_reading.before: Hell is simply announced as a later penalty.
changed_reading.after: Hell is the measured terminal result of a condition disclosed through life-and-death testing under the Lord's rule.

context_deltas.mechanism: Preparation and ignition precede people being cast into a place that draws breath, boils, and has keepers; جهنم as المصير changes from a static coordinate into an active receiving and containing system.

activation_trace.role: Painful punishment keeps the active receiver model tied to the focus consequence.
A place of settlement supplies the spatial anchor that context makes dynamic.
A present, readied provision makes the punishment prearranged and awaiting entrants.
Ignition supplies the active thermal state of the prepared destination.
Casting supplies forced transfer into the receiving place.
Drawing breath gives the destination an organism-like intake.
Boiling and surging supply internal processing rather than inert location.
A custodian charged with keeping adds an administered containment layer.

structural_cues: The focus names Hell, and the immediately adjacent verses first prepare it and then narrate entry into it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies readiness, ignition, casting, inhalation, boiling, and custodians; I infer a receiver-like system from their sequence. The live alternative is vivid personification of a place with no claim about a literal organism or apparatus.

changed_reading.before: The destination is a static place where punishment occurs.
changed_reading.after: The destination is staged as an already prepared receiver that takes entrants in, surges around them, and keeps them contained.

context_deltas.mechanism: Warning is followed by denial and failure to hear responsively or use restraining reason, then by acknowledgment of guilt; كفروا becomes a recoverable process of refused reception rather than an unexplained group label.

activation_trace.role: Denial and obstruction of truth provide the focus act whose stages context discloses.
A fear-awakening warning supplies the offered interruption before refusal.
Contradiction of truth names the explicit rejection step.
Hearing as understanding and compliance shows that acoustic access alone was insufficient.
Reason that restrains ignorance supplies the unused internal check on denial.
Acknowledgment reverses concealment by making the rejected truth personally conceded.
Named guilt identifies the refusal chain as culpable rather than merely mistaken.

structural_cues: 67:8-11 supplies a narrated retrospective in the voices of those who have entered the destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warning, denial, nonresponsive hearing, unused restraint, and confession; I infer these as stages unpacking كفروا. A live alternative is that hearing and reasoning summarize broad negligence rather than a strict chronological chain.

changed_reading.before: Those punished are identified only as disbelievers.
changed_reading.after: Those punished are shown to have received an awakening warning, denied it, declined responsive hearing and restraint, and finally exposed their own guilt.

context_deltas.mechanism: Unseen, secret, and public domains are all placed under knowledge that reaches the inward source and subtle detail; the covering in كفر can suppress recognition within the agent but cannot hide its object or motive from رب.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the attempted concealment whose limits context exposes.
The one attending and completing the creature anchors intimate rather than remote knowledge.
Hiddenness from eyes distinguishes faithful response without sight from concealment of truth.
Keeping speech inward supplies the concealed pole of the knowledge test.
Open declaration supplies the opposite pole, leaving no disclosure state outside the frame.
Knowledge as disclosure to the knower cancels concealment as an escape mechanism.
The inward source from which acts issue locates knowledge upstream of outward speech.
Fineness and hidden subtlety extend cognition into what ordinary inspection misses.
Knowledge of inward reality completes the failure of concealment.

structural_cues: 67:12 contrasts unseen reverence with 67:13-14's total access to secret, public, and inward states.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hiddenness, secrecy, publicity, inward origin, subtlety, and interior knowledge; I infer that كفر's covering operates as self-obscuration, not successful concealment from the Lord. The alternative is a simpler omniscience contrast without a lexical return to كفر.

changed_reading.before: Disbelief is a proposition held against the Lord.
changed_reading.after: Disbelief is also an inward covering that may block the coverer while remaining fully exposed to the Lord who knows its secret and public forms.

context_deltas.mechanism: Made-tractable ground, apportioned provision, and birds continuously held aloft reveal Lordship as ongoing support; deceptive self-sufficiency covers that dependence, so عذاب can include the withdrawal or interruption of what had quietly sustained life.

activation_trace.role: Covering benefaction supplies the failure to register continuous support.
Ongoing tending makes ordinary stability an effect of Lordship.
Prevention and weaning let punishment be modeled as loss of sustaining access.
Making difficult ground tractable supplies a normally unnoticed environmental affordance.
Apportioned giving identifies food and access as received support.
Continuous holding keeps flight from being treated as autonomous stability.
Merciful tenderness identifies sustaining restraint as beneficent rather than mechanical.
Deception by an unstable appearance explains how dependence can be covered.
The repeated apportioned gift makes provision both ongoing and revocable.
Withholding turns the usually sustaining grip into a deprivation mechanism.

structural_cues: 67:15 and 67:19-21 alternate ordinary mobility and provision with questions about who holds or can withhold them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tractability, apportioned provision, continuous holding, possible withholding, and deceptive confidence; I infer that punishment may work partly by removal of sustaining gifts. The live alternative is additive punishment while ordinary support merely proves power and dependence.

changed_reading.before: Punishment is an added pain imposed after disbelief.
changed_reading.after: Punishment may also expose denied dependence by withholding the mobility, provision, and holding that the nurturing Lord continuously supplied.

context_deltas.mechanism: The contrast between face-down and upright walking turns المصير from a detached endpoint into صيرورة: bodily orientation, guidance, and route are already forming the destination.

activation_trace.role: Becoming toward an end allows present movement to participate in the final outcome.
Blame evaluates the trajectory's realized end.
Actual movement supplies the process connecting orientation to arrival.
Being overturned onto the face supplies a self-obstructing mode of progress.
Gentle direction toward the true path identifies orientation as guidance, not mere locomotion.
Integrity and upright completeness supply the contrasting gait.
A straight road supplies the directional medium in which becoming unfolds.
Rectitude and balance stabilize the route opposed to face-down motion.

structural_cues: 67:22 is a balanced comparison of two walkers, two orientations, and implicitly two outcomes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed gaits, guidance, uprightness, and a straight road; I infer that present orientation causally forms المصير. The alternative is that the walking scene only illustrates current guidance and leaves the future endpoint logically separate.

changed_reading.before: The bad destination waits at the end of an otherwise unspecified life.
changed_reading.after: The bad destination is already being made through face-down, self-obstructing movement, while upright guided walking embodies the alternative becoming.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hearing, sight, and inward cognition are created gifts whose expected return is gratitude; كفروا بربهم therefore sharpens into covering both the giver and the evidentiary capacities through which nurture could be recognized.

activation_trace.role: Covering a benefaction names the inverse of gratitude.
Tending and completion identify the faculties as nurtured endowments.
Bringing into existence makes the recipient's capacities received rather than self-originating.
Understanding and responsive compliance supply one intended use of the created faculty.
Inner discernment makes sight an evidentiary capacity, not only an organ.
The inwardly kindled heart supplies the integrative center for hearing and sight.
Recognition of benefit and praise of its giver states the response that covering negates.

structural_cues: 67:23 lists origin, faculties, and scarce gratitude in one compact sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies created faculties and their expected grateful return; I infer that underusing them is a mechanism of كفر toward رب. A live alternative is that ingratitude is one consequence of disbelief rather than its internal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Disbelief concerns refusal of a claim about the Lord.
changed_reading.after: Disbelief is ingratitude enacted through created faculties that fail to recognize and answer the nurture that made them possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: A promised event whose timing is challenged becomes suddenly near, visible, and registered as distress on faces; المصير shifts from indefinitely remote future to an approaching reality whose arrival collapses denial.

activation_trace.role: The final outcome supplies what moves from remoteness into realized proximity.
Grief and aversion supply the affective force later manifested on faces.
A promise indexed to a time or place supplies the challenged future event.
Fulfillment in deed supplies the criterion by which the warning is tested.
Direct seeing replaces speculative distance with perceptual encounter.
A rush into nearness supplies the temporal-spatial collapse.
Experienced distress makes the badness of the outcome immediately felt.
The face becomes the visible surface on which failed denial is registered.

structural_cues: 67:25 asks when; 67:27 answers narratively with sight, nearness, and altered faces.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a challenged timed promise followed by near sight and facial distress; I infer that the sequence dramatizes a collapse from deferred المصير to present encounter. The alternative is a scene change whose nearness is spatial only, not a comment on denial's temporal strategy.

changed_reading.before: The destination is a remote future abstraction that can be postponed mentally.
changed_reading.after: The promised destination advances into sight, and its badness becomes legible on the deniers' faces at the instant distance collapses.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing loss-of-water question activates dormant sweet-water and withholding branches inside عذاب: punishment can be heard as an anti-refreshment in which sustaining sweetness sinks beyond reach and no agent can restore its spring.

activation_trace.role: Sweet, palatable water supplies the positive state whose contextual disappearance colors punishment by reversal.
Prevention and weaning provide the bridge from unavailable water to deprivation as punishment.
Painful penalty remains the governing sense and prevents the water reversal from replacing the verse's explicit punishment.
Water itself supplies the indispensable sweet resource at risk.
Descent into inaccessible depth supplies the loss mechanism.
Bringing or coming frames restoration as an agency question no creature can answer.
A flowing spring supplies the accessible form of water whose return is sought.

structural_cues: The surah closes on an unanswered question about sweet, flowing water after repeatedly presenting provision as held and revocable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies عذاب's sweet-water, withholding, and pain branches plus a final tableau of water sinking beyond retrieval; I infer a reversal that colors punishment as deprivation of refreshment. The live alternative is that 67:30 illustrates dependence without intentionally activating the lexical neighborhood of عذاب.

changed_reading.before: عذاب denotes painful punishment with no material contrast in view.
changed_reading.after: Without displacing pain, عذاب can also resonate as the withholding of sweet, sustaining access: an anti-spring whose refreshment has sunk beyond recovery.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the enclosure branch of مصير is livestock-domain and the focus does not animalize its subjects. It remains anchored in مصير and is activated by cohorts, custodians, and gathering toward a goal; downstream prose should render it only as a spatial-administrative analogy, not a lexical replacement or zoological claim.

activation_trace.role: A livestock enclosure supplies the strange but focus-anchored containing geometry.
A human cohort supplies repeated grouped intake into the enclosure-like destination.
A custodian responsible for keeping supplies administered containment.
Driving and collecting a group toward one goal supplies the convergent movement into confinement.

changed_reading.before: Hell is a bad destination understood only as a place-name.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, Hell is spatialized as a managed enclosure into which cohorts are driven, received, and kept.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because seed-covering is an agricultural branch of كفر and normally enables growth rather than guilt. It remains anchored in كفر and the packet's nurture, young-growth, sowing, and watering images; downstream prose should call it an inverted cultivation analogy, not an etymology of disbelief or a claim that the verse literally depicts farming.

activation_trace.role: Covering seed with soil supplies the agricultural action that is morally inverted.
Feeding and growth supply the Lordly cultivation that should bring the covered potential to emergence.
Fresh plant emergence supplies a material image for gratitude becoming visible.
Sowing the earth extends the cultivation sequence from buried seed toward intended growth.
Delivery of water supplies the final enabling input whose loss leaves burial without emergence.

changed_reading.before: كفروا marks denial without a material growth model.
changed_reading.after: As a contained agricultural analogy, they cover entrusted potential but produce no grateful emergence, turning seed-covering from cultivation into sterile burial.

strongest_changes: The focus verdict becomes the measured result of a revealing test under the same sovereignty it rejects.
Hell changes from a static endpoint into a prepared, breathing, boiling, and administered receiver.
كفروا is unpacked as a sequence of warning, denial, unused hearing and restraint, and eventual confession.
المصير becomes path-dependent becoming and then collapses from mocked remoteness into near visible arrival.
The final inaccessible-water scene activates an exploratory anti-sweetness and withholding layer inside عذاب.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly converted compact nouns in 67:6 into mechanisms: رب became continuous nurture and holding, كفر became both concealed dependence and failed gratitude, المصير became an active trajectory and receiver, and the final water question reopened otherwise dormant branches of عذاب.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the withdrawal-of-support model is part of punishment itself or only an analogy proving dependence.
Whether the breathing receiver should remain rhetorical personification or support a stronger system-like reading.
Whether the water and cultivation activations are deliberate lexical resonances or useful but branch-distant exploratory overlays.
